rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises during an ice storm, which is a covered liability scenario involving the condition of the policyholder's walkway.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter fell on the policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm last week and sustained a broken wrist. Parents are pursuing medical bills. This is a premises liability claim with pediatric injury requiring urgent adjuster attention.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Child slipped and fell on icy walkway during ice storm
